findings.passage: Currently the number one threat to our republic's foundation is the security and integrity of elections. Federal law and Article VII of the Pennsylvania Constitution call for an election day, not an election season. To protect against fraud early voting should be limited to absentee ballots, which should be issued to those who cannot physically make it to the polls. A picture ID should be required to vote at the polling place. Non-secure elections undermine the most basic and foundational element of our republic. Our election process MUST be trustworthy and accurately record the will of the electorate.
findings.note: His written answer in the York Daily Record candidate Q&A (published on Yahoo) for the 92nd District primary. Covers photo ID at the polling place, limits on early voting, and election security.
subjects: limits on early and absentee voting

findings.passage: Aside from education, Marc’s priorities include protecting personal rights and liberties, improving the economy, increasing government transparency and accountability, and ensuring election integrity.
findings.note: Biography page on his own site lists election integrity among his priorities. Page is undated.
